title: Access Barrier to Fix Map
placeholder: Click any barrier or fix to see what it is and what it addresses.

nodes.label: Cost
detail: The barrier
Fees, or the equipment a family is expected to already own.
Note
The only barrier here with three fixes converging on it -- and going no-fee removes it for every family at once.

nodes.label: Transportation
detail: The barrier
No way to physically reach the venue at the session time.

nodes.label: Inflexible Timing
detail: The barrier
One fixed slot that collides with work, worship, care duties, or another commitment.

nodes.label: Language
detail: The barrier
Materials and contact only in a language the family does not read comfortably.

nodes.label: Disability Access
detail: The barrier
A venue, activity, or material a student cannot use as provided.

nodes.label: No-Fee Model
detail: The fix
Charge nothing. One policy decision that removes the cost barrier for every family without anyone having to ask.

nodes.label: Scholarship Fund
detail: The fix
Money set aside to cover fees for families who ask. Works, but requires the family to identify themselves as needing it.

nodes.label: Free Device Loan Program
detail: The fix
The club lends the hardware, so 'bring a laptop' stops being a hidden fee.

nodes.label: Carpool, Transit, or Virtual Option
detail: The fix
More than one way to be present: a shared ride, a transit pass, or attending remotely.

nodes.label: Alternating Saturday and Weekday Sessions
detail: The fix
Two slots rather than one, so a single recurring conflict does not exclude a family for the whole term.

nodes.label: Translated Materials and Bilingual Contact
detail: The fix
Key documents in the languages families actually read, and a named person who can talk to them.

nodes.label: Direct Accommodation Request
detail: The fix
Ask the family what they need rather than guessing, and then do it.
